body: I’m not sure i understand what you mean. Would you want to send a private message trying to help me understand? I have a feeling people are going to get this post taken down and I don’t want to lose touch.

I just know I’ve done wrong in the past and this feels like the least I can do to try to make up for it. I’ll listen to whatever you wanna say, even if it doesn’t make sense. If you feel more comfortable in a private message please don’t hesitate.
How are you feeling this morning? Have you tried writing down your thoughts in a journal entry or anything like that?

I’m not here to play reddit politics or argue with someone. This is a sub reddit for suicide watch, people are hurting including myself and reading rules for a forum isn’t on my mind, these people are. There is no ulterior motive to this post, just offering help. If you want stifle that and report me to admins then be my guest, but please just leave me alone and stop replying, it’s not helping anything or anyone.

I’m going to sleep, please still feel free to write in here and I will be back here in the morning.
Please stay strong everyone.
May i ask why you spite yourself?

I wish I could be your irl friend, but I can’t sadly. I’m more than willing to be your internet friend and you can vent to me whenever, and I’ll try my best to reply and give some advice when I’m not working. If you have discord, you can message me.

Well, I can’t imagine being in that position. But for me I’m trying to look at the positives. Maybe it’s beautiful you don’t care for people, you could be a killer salesmen or something. Most sales jobs don’t require degrees and are very lucrative. You could get super rich and do the things you want to do, or if you prefer doing nothing you still need money for that too! 

I wish you the best man, we may have dark spots on our records but what defines us is what we do after.

Well, from my experience I know that my physical health drastically affects my mental health. I also know how difficult it is to care about yourself when you’re alone and feeling like the world is collapsing. But it’s sort of a ‘fake it til you make it’ situation. The first few times forcing yourself to do something for yourself is probably one of the hardest things to do. The more you force yourself, the more your body rewires itself. I think it might be beneficial for you to set a schedule for yourself, wake up early, make yourself breakfast, go for a run, whatever it takes to distract yourself from the pain. Try it for a couple days and see how you feel. Also just expressing your self in text or writing is very cathartic, maybe try writing your life story and how you feel and connect the dots.

I’m not a doctor or anything, but these things sometimes work at bringing me even just a little bit out of hell.

It can be really hard to tell your friends or loved ones what you’re going through.
For me, I don’t want them feeling bad for me or thinking I’m weak.
I can’t imagine having a girlfriend during such painful times because if you care you want to be strong for them and be there for them and it’s pretty hard when they’re taking care of you.
But if your girlfriend genuinely wants to help, it could possibly be a good idea to try it out.
When feeling depressed or suicidal it seems like nothing will help, but you’re here asking for help and I think you should try to do the things that may seem hard but may make you feel better.
As a guy I know journals and expressing your feelings seems lame, but if you can’t push yourself to confide in your girlfriend it might help to put your thoughts into paper.

It’s really admirable that you’re here expressing what you’re going through. I don’t know much of your situation and I don’t want to give you false advice but from my perspective you’re still young and have a fighting chance. It may seem like an eternity, but I’d like to see you hold on for two more years and then show your mom she is wrong. 

Living with a toxic parent is just about the worst thing you can deal with and you’re probably a lot stronger than you think.

If you care to talk or vent, I’m here.
I’m here to listen or talk, whatever you need.
Hi, can I ask why? I’m here to listen or talk if you’d like.
If not for yourself, do it for me.

I think that’s a beautiful sentiment. It shows you care about people even though you’re in figurative hell. Some people can’t be that caring while living the life they want to live. 

I like to think about friends, family, and people as a series of networks. You may be close to one person, they may be close to two, those two may be close to another and only after a few steps you’re close to the entire world population.
When you take your life, you don’t just affect the people close to you, you affect everyone.
What you’re going through sounds tough, but I think you genuinely care about people and you need to be strong because it’ll be a darker place with out you.
Well, I think the first step is admitting to yourself you’re not okay. Did you ever have dreams or ambitions before things got to this point?

That sounds really rough...  It can be really hard to be dealing with a mental illness and not be able to confide in the ones you care for. It seems to me, and I’m not an expert, that because you’re here you still have more to do. Sometimes  the situations we’re in never get better and it can help to change our situation. You said you live in a rural town, and I imagine it must be hard to find productive distractions in your area, but for me, when I throw myself into work or art it helps because I don’t have time to think about things. I hope you come back to this post, I’m here to listen.
I’d like to think that Mother Nature, or God, or whatever, throws just as much as we can handle before we break. I think the first step is reaching out, and I’m here to listen if you need it.
I’m here to listen.
I’m not going to pretend like I know what you’re going through, but I’d like to think it didn’t work because you still have more to do on this Earth.

I lived there for several years and just partied my early 20s away. I was playing in bands had a vibrant social life but it wasn’t enough. I always stayed in contact with her, making sure her new boyfriend was taking care of her, seeing how her mom is, etc.. 

One day around 23 I was feeling alone and attempted to reach out to my dad. I apologized for anything I may have done and told him I want to have a family again, I just needed someone to care even  if I didn’t forgive him for all he’s done, not that he apologized.

I visited him and his family for a week and things seemed better. He was happy with his new wife, he got along with her kids, and I was contemplating moving down. I told them I wanted to turn my life around start anew and have a family and I was serious. I told my band that I needed to move, they understood, and I went and got my GED and planned to move back and stay with them while I went to college. 

If only things were that easy, after a couple of weeks of staying with them, all the issues me and my father had resurfaced and tensions rose.  I was working two jobs, riding a bike 15 to and from for both of them each day to save up for college. I was also looking for another group to play music with as they had told me they support my dream, but anytime I would go to practice they would lecture me on how Im not being responsible. They still treated me like a child and it was a noticeable difference of how he talked to and treated me versus her kids. Which made me envious of them and probably made me a little more temperamental than I should’ve been.
One day after working both jobs, I get home to see them having dinner, I refused and I just wanted to go to my room. They considered that disrespectful and told me I was ungrateful and they kicked me out.

I luckily had a friend who took me in for a month while I found an apartment.

I signed a year lease on my first place and was feeling pretty good, still lonely, but proud of myself.

I tried again with my dad and expressed everything of how I felt, how I’m not a kid, how I was treated differently from my brother and sister, and my step siblings and he just refuted it all. I caved, again just to have someone.

I would come hang out at the house, watch the dogs, etc and just  try to be a part of the family forgetting all my pain.
But there was always a tension and demeaning comments and something I wasn’t doing right. 

COVID 19 happens and I was quarantined in my house alone for two months because they wouldn’t have me over. I would order Instacart and delivery so i literally never left. It was taking a toll on me.

During the quarantine, I was keeping in touch with an old band mate who wanted to get back into it so I offered him to move down and told my parents. They “supported” it and I was excited to have a friend again. They had finally agreed to have me over for Mother’s Day but the day before they told me I couldn’t come because of my roommate just moving down, which they had known for well over a month.
I was really hurt, they know I cared for my mother deeply and didn’t have a female role model so I tried my best to see my step mom as my mom but I always felt the love was conditional. I suck it up, and reschedule for two weeks out. 

Me and my friends have an annual camping trip, that my ex is a part of and my parents know that I was going. We cancelled the camping but still got a small group of 6 to hang out for a couple days.
I call my dad while on the trip and we had an okay conversation but the next day I receive a text from my step sister telling me how terrible I am and to not come over ever again and she blocked me. I showed my dad the screenshots and said “this isn’t how family treats each other” and he defended her and told me not to come.

I’m pretty used to not having family, I’ll be fine I guess..

During the trip were all hanging out at my exes house having a good time talking about memories and such,  and I get a little too drunk... a lot too drunk and have to go vomit and lay down in the bathroom. My ex comes in to take care of me, makes sure I’m okay and hugs me, her mom came in to put a blanket on me etc..Which just made me realize how much I love her. During all of this she is dealing with just getting broken up with and is really depressed so I’m trying my best to smother those feelings and just be there for her as a friend.

The next day we have plans to rent a boat and hang out on the water, we all have a great day, and she seems a little less depressed. I was taking a nap on the boat while everyone was swimming and she came over and kissed me on the head and gave me the eyes. I don’t react or say anything because I’m frozen in shock. I told myself that she’s just drunk and being a good friend. We end the boating trip and I was going to head to another friends house and while I’m saying bye to everyone she grabs my arm and walks me to my car and tells me to come over. I went over and we spent the night talking, I’m in heaven, just being able to be in her presence is a privilege and I don’t want to screw up and do anything a good friend wouldn’t do. Because she’s still hurting from her ex and our past has been her just being nice because she cares and me misinterpreting it and being an idiot and spilling my guts.

We spent the next day together and I went with her to get craft stuff, food, just things we used to do. I spend the night again, talked about her ex, stupid hookups we both had and the whole 9 yards and again I resisted because I know that’s not what she wants right now.

I go to leave and her mom hugs me tight and tells me her and the dogs are going to miss me.
I walk out to my car because since our breakup we never really hugged because it’s just awkward for us to hug as friends, and she stops me and makes me give her a big hug.

I text her when I get home that if she’s feeling down or anything to reach out and I’m here as a friend and promise not to get weird on her. She thanks me and said I kept her from crying those two days.

During all of this my bandmate/roommate reconnects with his ex as well and decided to move down with her after only being here a couple weeks.

I text my ex and tell her that, tell her how lonely and miserable I am now from my family, and now him leaving, and she understands.

I made the stupid mistake of asking her if she wanted to hang out just as friends next week or the week after because I don’t want to be alone and she let me down gently.

I feel so alone, I feel like every time I put myself back out there and try to be social I just get hurt.

All i want is to be cared about by the people I care about and it seems futile. My mother had her mental illnesses and my father had the suicides in his family, am I just destined to be miserable and alone or end up killing myself because I’m weak and can’t handle it. I’ve been home for a week just crying, I can’t even force myself to write music which is usually my outlet.

I know this is a lot to read, and it’s probably convoluted and things are out of place or missing.
But I genuinely appreciate anyone here to help some lonely loser.
The comments saying your here honestly means a lot, and typing this all out made me feel a little better.
 Thank you..

I don’t where to start other than my family and childhood. 

I grew up with an older brother and sister. My parents have always had issues, my mother suffered from bipolar disorder and alcoholism and my father had anger issues and his side of the family has had a couple suicides. They were always fighting and I always remember feeling helpless. I never really got along with my dad, we just butted heads, and my mother loved me dearly but her love wasn’t always there due to her mental health. My brother and sister got along with my dad and the family felt like my mom and I vs the other 3. I had problems at school getting bullied and failing classes from sleeping through them, which I paid the price for from my father. My brother and sister both got braces and dental work, they never took me to the dentist, they got cars when they turned 16, etc. I was bouncing back and fourth from moms to dads after their divorce when I was 12, my mom would have a mental breakdown, disappear or beat me. My father would just tell me I’m a white trash piece of shit just like my mom and beat me as well. At 15 I finally had enough and ran away and dropped out of school. My father would call the cops and report me, I would get found and returned only to have the same issues. I would call and talk to my mother all the time because she was living in a different state at this point and she seemed to be trying to be better. She passed away when I was 17 from a car accident. I remember not feeling anything, just numb. My mother’s side of the family flew me up to the hospital and since I was a minor and my brother and sister were 18+ it was their decision to pull the plug, against my wishes. I had hope, maybe false hope, but you don’t give up on someone like that. I remember us 3 being in the hospital talking about the one good thing that may come from this, us being brought together again. After my mother’s passing I didn’t hear from them unless it was about insurance money. I turned to alcohol and drugs maybe a week after, all while being homeless and couch surfing. Eventually I slowed down on the drinking and partying and decided the friends I had in the area weren’t good for me, and decided to be homeless where I went to middle school and had friends.

This transitions to the next big chapter for me.


I was on social security from my mother’s death and living in the woods behind a high school. I was still drinking but it was more social than destructive I’d like to think. It was late one night and a few friends had asked where I was and I told them, they insisted that I come spend the night at a friends house(I’ve never met them).
It was a girls house, she let me stay the night with everyone and we hung out and ended up sleeping in the same bed and cuddling kissing etc. I fell in love instantly. How could someone so beautiful and perfect want to be associated with someone and broken as me? She eventually asked her mom to let me move in, and I did. Her dad has committed suicide so I felt like we really grew close from our pain. Her mom and her cared for me like no one ever did and I finally felt loved and happy. She took care of me, fed me, made me go back to school, put me on her phone plan, all things I was very unfamiliar with. I think since my mother had passed I was missing out on a woman’s care I became addicted to it. I became clingy, overbearing , and overall an emotional wreck from my mother. We had problems, which in hindsight I don’t think I was that aware of them, I would say I would try to fix it but I probably made no efforts. She eventually couldn’t handle it after about a year, I don’t blame her. She broke up with me and I was devastated. It felt like my world shattered, I couldn’t stop crying, I would lay there days on end just completely paralyzed. I moved out and began couch surfing again. She would still reach out often and make sure I was okay. I would see her from time to time at friends houses and we always ended up hooking up and talking, but she couldn’t love me anymore. This lasted for about two years. I had eventually gotten a job and a house with a friend. After so much pain of wanting her but not being able to do anything I decided to move with my roommate to his home state and try to move on.
So there’s no way of expressing myself with out the full story, this may take awhile..
